reason: NIGHT SHIFT survived the three-direction cull on 2026-09-03: LEDGER OF LIGHT was a category template any audit tool could ship, GLASS CORRIDOR needed a photoreal interior and a MetaHuman that one RTX 3070 Ti cannot finish. NIGHT SHIFT puts the product where the argument is: the world stops until a person says yes.
thesis: At 3am an agent walks a dark data hall alone; the film is the moment it reaches for something that cannot be undone and the world stops until a person says yes.
visualMetaphor: A monochrome data hall at night with one orange point of light for the agent. The signature move is THE HOLD: the whole 3D world freezes mid-motion while the interface decides, and the freeze itself is the transition between the argument ground (the hall) and the evidence ground (the rebuilt DashClaw UI).
soundIntent: Sound-design led, narration on top. Low room tone and rack fans; the agent is a soft rising tone; the hold is an abrupt full stop of every sound except the room; the release is the fans coming back; soft out-of-phase ticks under the wide finale. Narrated, sparse, about 85 words in 40 seconds.

dials.ground: a live 3D field (Unreal data hall) for the argument, rebuilt UI for the evidence
dials.camera: continuous slow moves, cuts only at ground flips
dials.type: mono (JetBrains Mono) that gets out of the way; the world carries the voice
dials.texture: grain and halation, fog in the hall
dials.colour: monochrome hall plus one signal, brand orange; green only as the product finished state
dials.productLiteralness: metaphor in the hall, literal rebuilt UI in the inbox and ledger
dials.voice: narrated, sparse, about 85 words in 40 s

paletteNote: Ground #0e1014 in both registers; hall surfaces are the surface tokens #15171c / #1d2026 with white slit lights. Accent #f97316 is the agent itself and the held state; #22c55e appears only as the ledger verified tick; CTA text is #fb923c. The accent never touches the hall lights, rack faces, fog, type, rules, the mark wash, or any background — a wash fails judge-palette by design.

signatureMove.name: THE HOLD
signatureMove.description: Whenever the agent reaches for a dangerous action the whole 3D world freezes mid-motion (the light stops, the fog stops, the camera stops) while the interface decides. The freeze is the PLATE holding one frame; the UI on top never freezes.

filmFrames.rhythm: shot 7, dozens of agents freezing and releasing out of phase

riskGuard: At 70% a 3D hall reads as a cheap game level. Guard: primitives only, no asset packs, fog and slit lights do the work, nothing photoreal is attempted, so nothing photoreal can fail.
wrongFor: a consumer app, anything playful, anything that wants a face

intendedAttributes: monochrome data hall, primitives only, no asset packs
white slit lights and ExponentialHeightFog carry the depth
reflective dark floor so the agent light has a second life
